description.zh: 设备描述、读写、动作、任务、租约与实验记录组成统一接口；可通过已有驱动生态接入。适合研究精简设备说明与按需发现。
description.en: A device contract covering descriptors, reads, writes, actions, jobs, leases and run records, with bridges to existing drivers. Useful for studying a compact device interface and on-demand discovery.

evidence.zh: 公开规范与实现；supported-devices 的 7 个设备包标为 twin tested，另有 1 个人工操作模板。维护者明确尚未确认这些驱动的实机运行。
evidence.en: Published specification and implementation. Seven supported-device packages are marked twin tested, plus one manual-operation template; maintainers explicitly distinguish these from hardware-tested drivers.

description.zh: 以 capability tag 和设备基类统一传感器、执行器及状态；提供串口机械臂适配示例。独立社区实现。
description.en: Capability tags and a device base class describe sensors, actuators and state, with a serial robotic-arm adapter. An independent community implementation.

evidence.zh: 源码包含 mock 设备和串口驱动；本次材料未提供具体实机验证记录。
evidence.en: Source includes mock devices and a serial driver; the reviewed material does not document a named hardware validation run.

description.zh: 设备注册、统一命令和 MCP 工具；包含机器人动作与技能执行扩展。与同名项目分别维护。
description.en: Device registration, common commands and MCP tools, extended with robot motion and skill execution. Maintained separately from other similarly named projects.

evidence.zh: 已读 MCP 调用分派代码；物理设备与 MuJoCo 示例需按各自后端区分。
evidence.en: MCP dispatch code reviewed. Physical-device and MuJoCo examples must be assessed by their individual backends.

description.zh: 统一设备接口加显式后端策略，覆盖 VISA 仪器、嵌入式 I/O 与模拟设备。属于受 MHS 启发的社区工程。
description.en: A common device interface with explicit backend policies for VISA instruments, embedded I/O and simulators. A community project inspired by MHS.

evidence.zh: 维护者列出 UNI-T UPO6102N 与 UTG2062X 的实机验证；其余摄像头、GPIO 等条目仍分别标为实验性或模拟。
evidence.en: Maintainers report real-hardware verification for UNI-T UPO6102N and UTG2062X; other camera and GPIO adapters have separate experimental or simulation status.

description.zh: 以 discover、read、write、execute 组织设备驱动和共享状态。包名 khp，与 OpenMHP 不是同一项目。
description.en: Organizes drivers and shared state around discover, read, write and execute. Distributed as khp; distinct from OpenMHP.

evidence.zh: 公开规范、SDK 与驱动目录；README 的 production grade 定位没有在本次材料中形成跨设备实测依据。
evidence.en: Public specification, SDKs and driver directory. The README’s production-grade description is not treated as evidence of cross-device validation.

description.zh: discover–reserve–execute–release 生命周期；节点、适配器与传输插件分离，可本地运行或使用可选注册与中继服务。
description.en: A discover–reserve–execute–release lifecycle separating nodes, adapters and transports, with local operation or optional registry and relay services.

evidence.zh: README 展示 Android 手机 ADB 操作；不能由此推定科研仪器的校准、长任务或读数语义已统一。
evidence.en: README demonstrates Android phone operation through ADB; this does not establish a shared scientific calibration, long-job or measurement model.

description.zh: 把现有 Jupyter 内核中的 QCoDeS Station 暴露给 Agent，复用参数、仪器快照、数据库与测量工作流。适合已使用 QCoDeS 的实验室。
description.en: Exposes a QCoDeS Station inside an existing Jupyter kernel, reusing parameters, snapshots, databases and measurement workflows. A direct route for QCoDeS laboratories.

evidence.zh: 已读参数发现、缓存与 fresh 读取路径；真实连接由运行中的内核及 QCoDeS 驱动持有。
evidence.en: Parameter discovery, caching and fresh-read code reviewed. The running kernel and QCoDeS drivers own the actual device connections.

description.zh: 无头物理设备执行平台：消息层、分层驱动、协议运行与结果记录分离。Agent 通过 CLI 和技能编写、验证、运行实验。
description.en: A headless physical-device runtime separating messaging, layered drivers, protocol execution and result records. Agents author, validate and run experiments through a CLI and skills.

evidence.zh: 已读 CLI 协议执行路径：运行前读取机器命令目录，经 NATS 分发；仓库含边缘驱动示例。
evidence.en: CLI execution path reviewed: it obtains the machine command catalogue before dispatch through NATS; the repository includes an edge-driver example.

description.zh: 跨设备实验室编排，结合动作、资源和实验室拓扑。框架、设备适配与工作流编译的分工值得比较。
description.en: Cross-device laboratory orchestration combining actions, resources and laboratory topology. Useful for comparing framework, adapter and workflow-compiler responsibilities.

evidence.zh: 论文与驱动目录展示物理实验路径。主框架 GPL-3.0；unilabos/devices/ 单独采用 DP Technology 专有许可。
evidence.en: The paper and driver tree describe physical laboratory operation. The framework is GPL-3.0; unilabos/devices/ is separately covered by a DP Technology proprietary license.

description.zh: 面向大型科学设施的 Agent 接口，处理通道语义寻址、设施知识、控制连接与操作过程。已有 EPICS、DOOCS、TANGO 连接器。
description.en: An agent interface for large scientific facilities: semantic channel addressing, facility knowledge, control connectors and operational workflows. Includes EPICS, DOOCS and TANGO connectors.

evidence.zh: 项目论文与设施应用提供实验背景；当前实现要求每次硬件写入经人工批准。
evidence.en: Project publications and facility applications supply experimental context; the current implementation requires human approval for every hardware write.

description.zh: 从已有 Python 自动化对象生成控制界面和工作流，包含可选的自然语言工作流设计功能。适合逐步接管已有设备代码。
description.en: Turns existing Python automation objects into controls and workflows, with optional natural-language workflow design. Useful for progressively exposing existing device code.

evidence.zh: 有实验室编排论文；当前 README 未声明原生 MCP 服务，不能把 Python API 自动等同于 MCP。
evidence.en: A laboratory-orchestration paper is available. The current README does not document a native MCP server; a Python API is recorded separately.

description.zh: 共享和租用真实或虚拟被测硬件，统一电源、串口、CAN、SPI、GPIO 与 USB 控制。Agent 可沿用测试脚本的接口。
description.en: Shares and leases physical or virtual devices under test, with power, UART, CAN, SPI, GPIO and USB drivers. Agents can use the same interfaces as test scripts.

evidence.zh: 公开驱动、Python 客户端、gRPC 定义与控制器；属于可被 Agent 使用的硬件基础设施，不是专门的科学语言模型。
evidence.en: Public drivers, Python client, gRPC definitions and controller. Agent-accessible hardware infrastructure rather than a specialized scientific language model.

description.zh: 用台架 Linux 主机集中连接电源、示波器、调试探针和总线；统一 CLI 可由 Agent、人工或 CI 使用，程序可在设备旁执行。
description.en: A bench Linux host connects supplies, scopes, debug probes and buses. A common CLI serves agents, humans and CI; programs can execute next to the devices.

evidence.zh: README 与文档提供具体仪器和台架部署路径；可复用的是台架执行层。
evidence.en: README and documentation describe concrete instruments and bench deployment. The reusable contribution is the bench execution layer.

description.zh: 面向需要视觉反馈的科学实验 Agent 运行环境；支持图像工具结果、确定性工作流及实验任务管理。
description.en: An experiment-agent runtime emphasizing visual feedback, image tool results, deterministic workflows and experiment task management.

evidence.zh: 有显微实验论文；README 已宣布迁移到 EAA-Pi。当前仓库未识别到顶层许可证。
evidence.en: A microscopy experiment publication is available; the README announces migration to EAA-Pi. No top-level license was identified.

description.zh: 基于 pi-experiment-ops 的实验助手界面，终端与网页共享工作区、工具配置和实验会话。
description.en: An experiment-assistant interface built on pi-experiment-ops; terminal and web views share workspaces, tools and experiment sessions.

evidence.zh: 作为 EAA 后继工程公开；实际仪器能力取决于接入的 MCP 服务，不能继承旧论文全部验证范围。
evidence.en: Published as EAA’s successor. Instrument capability depends on connected MCP servers; validation from the earlier paper is not automatically transferred.

description.zh: 组合实验工具、后台执行、持久终端和会话检索，为实验应用提供可复用 Agent 执行环境。
description.en: Combines experiment tools, background execution, persistent terminals and transcript search into a reusable agent runtime for experiment applications.

evidence.zh: MCP 适配器连接独立仪器服务；运行环境本身不提供通用设备驱动。
evidence.en: Its MCP adapter connects separate instrument services; the runtime itself does not provide universal device drivers.

description.zh: 单仓库仪器适配集合，覆盖电子测量、光谱、温控、泵、显微、液体处理和设施协议。组件清单单列，避免把服务器数量当作独立项目数量。
description.en: A monorepo of instrument adapters spanning electronic measurement, spectroscopy, temperature control, pumps, microscopy, liquid handling and facility protocols. Components are listed separately.

evidence.zh: 当前机器可读目录含 32 个服务器、411 个工具，全部标为 simulated；其中质谱数据和工作单工具不是直接设备控制。
evidence.en: The machine-readable catalogue lists 32 servers and 411 tools, all marked simulated. Mass-spectrometry data and worklist tools are not direct device control.

description.zh: 多种传输接口汇入同一 MCP 服务，便于把已有指令和脚本接给 Agent。设备语义主要仍由配置和驱动表达。
description.en: Brings several transports into one MCP server so agents can use existing commands and scripts. Device semantics remain primarily in configuration and drivers.

evidence.zh: 提供五类连接驱动与配置示例；通用通信能力不代表任意设备已经适配。
evidence.en: Five connection-driver families and configuration examples are documented; generic connectivity does not imply support for every device.

description.zh: 将示波器采集与测量目标封装为工具，仪器后端负责具体 SCPI。首个目标是 Rigol DS1054Z。
description.en: Wraps oscilloscope capture and measurement goals as tools, leaving SCPI details to instrument backends. The first target is the Rigol DS1054Z.

evidence.zh: 有 Rigol 与 mock 后端；README 明确不暴露任意原始 SCPI，且没有信号源或逻辑分析仪功能。
evidence.en: Rigol and mock backends are documented; the README explicitly excludes arbitrary raw SCPI, waveform-generator and logic-analyzer functions.

description.zh: 网络示波器设置、触发、波形读取和测量反馈；返回结构化数据、图像及可独立查看的波形页面。
description.en: Network oscilloscope configuration, triggering, waveform acquisition and measurement feedback, returning structured data, images and standalone waveform views.

evidence.zh: README 描述实际台架与 FPGA 调试路径；设备兼容性仍按项目列出的型号确认。
evidence.en: The README describes bench operation and FPGA debugging workflows; compatibility remains model-specific.

description.zh: LeCroy 示波器控制与波形采集，使用 LAN VXI-11 或 USB。
description.en: LeCroy oscilloscope control and waveform acquisition over LAN VXI-11 or USB.

evidence.zh: 仓库附运行演示；LAN 路径要求 VXI-11，README 明确不支持 LeCroy VICP 模式。
evidence.en: A running demonstration is included. The documented LAN path requires VXI-11 and explicitly excludes LeCroy VICP.

description.zh: Siglent 示波器和电源的类型化工具，记录实际发送的 SCPI 命令。
description.en: Typed tools for Siglent oscilloscopes and supplies, recording the SCPI commands applied.

evidence.zh: 维护者报告一次 SDS1204X HD 与 SPD3303X-E 台架验证，包括波形缩放链；其余列出型号不能一并视为实测。
evidence.en: Maintainers report one SDS1204X HD and SPD3303X-E bench session, including waveform scaling; other listed models are not all hardware-tested.

description.zh: Keysight/Agilent 示波器的设置、截图、波形下载、测量与串行解码。
description.en: Configuration, screenshots, waveform download, measurements and serial decoding for Keysight/Agilent oscilloscopes.

evidence.zh: README 指明实测 Agilent MSOX2024A，固件 02.43.2018020635。
evidence.en: README identifies testing on an Agilent MSOX2024A with firmware 02.43.2018020635.

description.zh: Digilent WaveForms 设备的示波器、任意波形与逻辑分析接口。
description.en: Oscilloscope, arbitrary-waveform and logic-analysis interfaces for Digilent WaveForms devices.

evidence.zh: 开源服务依赖单独取得的专有 libdwf/运行库；不能把服务端 MIT 许可理解为整个 SDK 开源。
evidence.en: The open server depends on separately obtained proprietary libdwf/runtime components; its MIT license does not cover the vendor SDK.

description.zh: 集成频谱分析仪、无线综测仪、电源、温箱及逻辑分析仪，使用 YAML 描述命令并管理多仪器会话。
description.en: Combines spectrum analyzers, radio testers, supplies, chambers and a logic analyzer using YAML command definitions and multi-instrument sessions.

evidence.zh: 列出 Keysight MXA/EXA、R&S CMW500 与 DSLogic 等适配目标；未识别到许可证。
evidence.en: Lists targets including Keysight MXA/EXA, R&S CMW500 and DSLogic; no license was identified.

description.zh: 发现 NI DAQ 设备并执行有限长度的模拟电压和数字输入采集。
description.en: Discovers NI DAQ devices and performs finite analog-voltage and digital-input acquisition.

evidence.zh: 社区项目；当前版本没有输出、连续采集或任意属性写入。NI 驱动独立安装。
evidence.en: A community project. The current version has no outputs, continuous acquisition or arbitrary property writes; NI drivers are installed separately.

description.zh: 厂商公开的无线采集 SDK 与 MCP 服务，涵盖通道配置、采样、数字 I/O、PWM、模拟输出和 SD 卡记录。
description.en: Vendor-published wireless DAQ SDK and MCP server covering channels, sampling, digital I/O, PWM, analog outputs and SD-card logging.

evidence.zh: README 将采集控制和记录下载连成完整路径；具体能力取决于 DAQiFi 设备型号。
evidence.en: The README connects acquisition control to recorded-data retrieval; capabilities depend on the DAQiFi device model.

description.zh: 让已有 LabVIEW 应用以工具、资源和提示的方式暴露 VI。适合直接包装实验室现有控制程序。
description.en: Exposes VIs in existing LabVIEW applications as tools, resources and prompts. A direct way to wrap established laboratory control programs.

evidence.zh: 开源工具包；LabVIEW 本体与仪器 VI 的依赖、许可分别存在。
evidence.en: The toolkit is open source; LabVIEW itself and instrument VI dependencies have separate licensing.

description.zh: Agent 可读取、修改和运行 LabVIEW 程序，主要处于开发工具层；能否控制设备取决于所运行 VI。
description.en: Lets agents read, modify and run LabVIEW programs. Primarily a development interface; physical control depends on the invoked VI.

evidence.zh: 依赖 LabVIEW 内部 lvai.LVAI 服务，README 明确它不是已发布、稳定承诺的 NI API。
evidence.en: Depends on the internal lvai.LVAI service, which the README identifies as an unpublished NI API without a stability commitment.

description.zh: 通过 OpenFlexure 客户端操作载物台、拍照、自动对焦、Z-stack 与扩展功能。
description.en: Uses the OpenFlexure client for stage motion, capture, autofocus, z-stacks and extension calls.

evidence.zh: 接入路径指向同一网络的真实 OpenFlexure 显微镜；仓库未给出系统化实测矩阵。
evidence.en: Targets an OpenFlexure microscope on the local network; the repository does not supply a systematic hardware test matrix.

description.zh: 面向 Nikon Ti2-E 与 Baumer 相机的紧凑接口，读位置、移动 XY、采图；图像与实际位置及状态修订号关联。
description.en: A compact interface for Nikon Ti2-E and a Baumer camera: position reads, XY motion and imaging, linking frames to actual stage position and revision counters.

evidence.zh: 提供 SDK 与 mock 路径；返回图像预览及完整文件。当前工具刻意不开放绝对 Z 移动。
evidence.en: SDK and mock paths return image previews and full files. Absolute Z motion is deliberately absent from the exposed tools.

description.zh: 将显微镜控制、机器人样本转移、图像分割、相似搜索和 OME-Zarr 数据组织在一起。
description.en: Combines microscope control, robotic sample transfer, segmentation, similarity search and OME-Zarr data handling.

evidence.zh: 公开服务注册代码与在线演示入口；主要设备调用经 Hypha 服务，未将原生 MCP 标作已确认接口。
evidence.en: Public service-registration code and a live-demo entry point; device calls primarily use Hypha services. Native MCP is not recorded as verified.

description.zh: 将研究目标转为有硬件边界与校准依据的显微镜配置，涵盖显微镜、光镊与压电平台。
description.en: Translates research goals into microscope configurations grounded in hardware limits and calibrations, spanning microscopy, optical tweezers and piezo stages.

evidence.zh: 已读设置、应用与回读代码。README 提醒光镊 TCP 接口的接受回执不等于动作完成，并宣布向 soft-matter-agents 迁移。
evidence.en: Configuration, application and readback code reviewed. The README distinguishes tweezers command acceptance from physical completion and announces migration to soft-matter-agents.

description.zh: 显微镜、模拟、文献与桥接 Agent 的组合工程；显微镜模块是旧 Agentic microscope 的后继位置。
description.en: Combines microscope, simulation, literature and bridge agents; the microscope module is the successor location for Agentic microscope.

evidence.zh: 作为迁移入口收录；各模块不都连接物理设备，具体硬件能力仍需查 microscope_agent。
evidence.en: Included as a migration target; not every module operates physical devices. Inspect microscope_agent for hardware capabilities.

description.zh: 原子力显微镜实验中的语言模型助手，结合任务分解、工具调用和反馈。
description.en: A language-model assistant for atomic-force-microscope experiments, combining task decomposition, tools and feedback.

evidence.zh: Nature Communications 论文报告实机 AFM 实验；代码与基准公开，重用需匹配论文的仪器控制环境。
evidence.en: The Nature Communications paper reports physical AFM experiments. Code and benchmarks are public; reuse requires a matching instrument-control environment.

description.zh: 扫描探针显微实验中的命令生成、知识库和专门小模型；包含本地模型服务与模型训练材料。
description.en: Command generation, knowledge retrieval and specialized small models for scanning-probe experiments, with local model services and training material.

evidence.zh: 论文描述物理扫描探针实验；仓库未识别到顶层许可证，模型训练代码与完整设备接入应分别评估。
evidence.en: The paper describes physical scanning-probe experiments. No top-level license was identified; model-training code and complete device integration should be assessed separately.

description.zh: 将仪器工作区变为参数、动作、图像回读与多步程序的固定工具接口；操作与后续观察分别记录。Nanonis 路径依赖外部 nqctl。
description.en: Turns instrument workspaces into a fixed tool surface for parameters, actions, image readbacks and multi-step programs. Actions and subsequent observations are recorded separately; Nanonis uses an external nqctl driver.

evidence.zh: 公开 Pi 扩展与工作区说明；STM 论文是相关实验背景，不据此宣称该扩展独立包含全部硬件驱动。
evidence.en: Public Pi extension and workspace contract. The STM paper supplies related experimental context, not evidence that this extension includes every hardware driver.

description.zh: 以语音或文字把用户意图转为束线操作代码，模块化处理转录、分类、编程与分析。
description.en: Translates spoken or written requests into beamline-operation code, with modules for transcription, classification, programming and analysis.

evidence.zh: 项目展示 NSLS-II 11-BM CMS 工作站部署和用户确认后执行；不是无人闭环的通用仪器协议。未识别到许可证。
evidence.en: The project shows deployment at NSLS-II 11-BM CMS, executing after user confirmation. It is not a universal unattended instrument protocol; no license was identified.

description.zh: 超导量子器件的脉冲实验、扫描、校准状态与分析框架；可向 Agent 提供实验描述及图文检查接口。
description.en: Pulse experiments, sweeps, calibration state and analysis for superconducting devices, with experiment descriptions and text/visual inspection hooks for agents.

evidence.zh: k-agents 论文报告量子校准实验；仓库同时提供模拟路径，应按后端识别实验来源。
evidence.en: The k-agents paper reports quantum-calibration experiments. The repository also offers simulation, so experimental provenance depends on the backend.

description.zh: 围绕已有实验库发现、执行和判断校准实验，保留实验知识与视觉结果。
description.en: Discovers, executes and evaluates calibration experiments through existing experiment libraries, retaining experimental knowledge and visual results.

evidence.zh: 论文有实机量子校准；README 已指向 NVIDIA Quantum Calibration Agent Blueprint。当前仓库未识别到许可证。
evidence.en: The paper reports physical quantum calibration. The README now points to NVIDIA’s Quantum Calibration Agent Blueprint; no license was identified in this repository.

description.zh: 量子器件校准 Agent 参考工程，包含实验发现、执行、图像分析、工作流和结果存储。
description.en: A quantum-device calibration agent reference implementation with experiment discovery, execution, visual analysis, workflows and result storage.

evidence.zh: NVIDIA 公开 Apache-2.0 工程，实验通过用户提供的 Python 脚本接入；不能把参考界面视为已覆盖所有量子控制器。
evidence.en: An NVIDIA Apache-2.0 project; experiments integrate through supplied Python scripts. The reference interface does not imply support for every quantum controller.

description.zh: 上下文与工具增强的科学设施助手，将仪器知识和操作函数纳入交互。
description.en: A context- and tool-augmented facility assistant integrating instrument knowledge with operational functions.

evidence.zh: 早期公开实现附演示；许可文本为三条款 BSD。后续机器人与束线工作另见 APS 仓库。
evidence.en: An earlier public implementation with a demonstration and a three-clause BSD license. Later robot and beamline work appears in the APS repository.

description.zh: 面向 North N9 机器人与 X-ray nanoprobe 的可教学实验 Agent 工作流。
description.en: Teachable experiment-agent workflows for a North N9 robotic station and an X-ray nanoprobe.

evidence.zh: README 列出机器人、纳米探针命令模块及运行视频；许可证未识别，分支以仓库当前默认分支为准。
evidence.en: README names robot and nanoprobe command modules and demonstration videos; no license was identified. Sources use the repository’s current default branch.

description.zh: 结合 API 文档检索与机器人协议上传、运行管理、归位及状态读取，面向 OT-2/Flex。
description.en: Combines API-documentation search with protocol upload, run management, homing and status access for OT-2/Flex.

evidence.zh: 设备调用走机器人 HTTP API；文档查询工具与会驱动机器人动作的工具分别存在。
evidence.en: Device calls use the robot HTTP API; documentation queries and physical-action tools are distinct.

description.zh: 将液体处理、酶标仪、热循环仪和加热振荡器操作暴露为 MCP，复用 PyLabRobot 后端。
description.en: Exposes liquid handling, plate reading, thermocycling and heater-shaker operations through MCP using PyLabRobot backends.

evidence.zh: 默认以 chatterbox 模拟器端到端验证；有真实 STAR 后端入口与接机说明，不能把模拟验证等同于实机验证。
evidence.en: End-to-end checks use the chatterbox simulator by default. A real STAR backend and bring-up guide are provided, separately from simulation verification.

description.zh: 自然语言液体处理工作流，包含 Opentrons、Biomek、Hamilton 与实验记录连接。
description.en: Natural-language liquid-handling workflows spanning Opentrons, Biomek, Hamilton and experiment-record integrations.

evidence.zh: 维护者报告 OT-2 读取、状态、归位与协议生成已接实机，上传/启动等执行工具尚未实机运行；Hamilton 和台式设备层为模拟。
evidence.en: Maintainers report physical OT-2 reads, status, homing and protocol generation; upload/start execution tools have not yet run on hardware. Hamilton and benchtop layers remain simulated.

description.zh: 面向 Opentrons 的 Agent 插件，集成协议编写、模拟、技能和实时运行辅助。
description.en: An Opentrons agent plugin combining protocol authoring, simulation, skills and live-runtime assistance.

evidence.zh: 当前采用 LabscriptAI Research Citation License，商业使用须另行许可；不列入标准开源许可组。
evidence.en: Currently uses the LabscriptAI Research Citation License, requiring separate permission for commercial use; listed outside the standard open-source-license group.

description.zh: 语言模型组织文献、程序和实验工具完成化学研究；是早期真实实验的重要案例。
description.en: A language model coordinates literature, code and experimental tools for chemical research; an important early physical-experiment case study.

evidence.zh: 论文报告机器人化学实验；公开代码不等于论文的完整可部署实验室。许可为 Apache-2.0 加 Commons Clause。
evidence.en: The paper reports robotic chemistry. Public code is not the complete deployable laboratory from the paper. License: Apache-2.0 with Commons Clause.

description.zh: 多 Agent 化学研究系统，连接实验协议、机器人工作站与实验数据。
description.en: A multi-agent chemical-research system connecting experimental protocols, a robotic workcell and experiment data.

evidence.zh: 仓库提供论文代码和实验数据，并把机器人指令与 AGV 驱动链接到其他仓库；本仓库未识别到许可证。
evidence.en: The repository provides paper code and experimental data, linking robot instructions and AGV drivers separately; no license was identified here.

description.zh: ORGANA 论文中的化学机器人助手结合用户目标、场景感知与实验进度；本仓库主要发布项目网站与研究材料。
description.en: The ORGANA paper combines user intent, scene perception and experiment progress in a chemistry robot assistant; this repository mainly publishes the project website and research material.

evidence.zh: 论文展示真实机器人实验；README 明确该仓库包含网站源码，没有据此确认完整机器人控制实现；许可证未识别。
evidence.en: The paper reports physical robot experiments. The README identifies this repository as website source, rather than establishing a complete robot-control release; no license was identified.

description.zh: 把自然语言实验步骤转换为可检查的 XDL 过程，验证错误反馈给模型进行修订。
description.en: Translates natural-language experiment steps into verifiable XDL procedures, feeding verification errors back to the model for revision.

evidence.zh: 论文含机器人执行；本仓库主要发布生成器与数据。README 指明旧代码接口已过时，更新版本在 develop 分支。
evidence.en: The paper includes robot execution; this repository mainly releases the generator and data. The README directs users to develop for updated API compatibility.

description.zh: 自然语言生成 Chemspyd 程序，把协议生成连接到 Chemspeed 自动化平台。
description.en: Generates Chemspyd programs from natural language, connecting protocol generation to Chemspeed automation.

evidence.zh: Chemspyd 论文链接的接口示例；未识别到本仓库许可证。
evidence.en: An interface example linked by the Chemspyd paper; no license was identified for this repository.

description.zh: 薄膜合成闭环中的多模态规划与假设检验，读取 XRD/SEM 数据，为下一次实验写出条件。
description.en: Multimodal planning and hypothesis testing in a thin-film synthesis loop, reading XRD/SEM data and writing conditions for the next experiment.

evidence.zh: 论文报告 18 次物理实验；公开程序通过 MaiML 输入与 output.txt 对接 dLab，未打包整套沉积、搬运与测量驱动。
evidence.en: The paper reports 18 physical experiments. Public code connects to dLab through MaiML input and output.txt, without packaging the complete deposition, transport and measurement stack.

description.zh: 生成实验步骤与 Lab Step Representation，支持多 Agent 修订和实验设计评估。
description.en: Generates experiment steps and Lab Step Representation, supporting multi-agent revision and experiment-design evaluation.

evidence.zh: 公开应用重点是设计、模拟和评估；不能仅凭论文的物理实验将此仓库当作完整硬件执行系统。
evidence.en: The public application emphasizes design, simulation and evaluation; physical experiments in the paper do not make this repository a complete hardware runtime.

description.zh: 把 OPC UA 节点浏览、单点与批量读写接到 Agent，保留已有工业设备服务端。
description.en: Connects OPC UA browsing and single-node or batch reads/writes to agents while retaining existing industrial servers.

evidence.zh: 是 OPC UA 到 MCP 的适配层；设备意义取决于服务端地址空间和信息模型。
evidence.en: An OPC UA-to-MCP adapter; physical meaning depends on the server address space and information model.

description.zh: 浏览、读数、历史、订阅、告警与受配置约束的写入及方法调用；一个本地进程连接一个 OPC UA 端点。
description.en: Browsing, reads, history, subscriptions, alarms and configured writes/method calls, with one local process per OPC UA endpoint.

evidence.zh: README 当前已包含写入能力，但默认只读；远程共享多客户端运行仍有单独设计约束。
evidence.en: The current README includes writes but defaults to read-only operation; shared remote multi-client deployment has separate design constraints.

description.zh: 把寄存器和线圈读写暴露为工具，是连接已有 PLC、传感器与控制器的底层入口。
description.en: Exposes register and coil reads/writes, providing a low-level route to existing PLCs, sensors and controllers.

evidence.zh: 具备通信调用接口；寄存器单位、比例、设备模式与副作用仍需设备映射表表达。
evidence.en: Communication calls are exposed; units, scaling, modes and side effects still require a device-specific register map.

description.zh: 从 TANGO 数据库发现设备，将属性、状态和命令映射为 MCP 资源与工具，支持批量读取。
description.en: Discovers devices through a TANGO database and maps attributes, state and commands to MCP resources and tools, including bulk reads.

evidence.zh: 提供具体 TANGO_HOST 部署与属性/命令路径；实际可操作范围由设施已有设备服务器决定。
evidence.en: Provides TANGO_HOST deployment and attribute/command paths; available operations depend on the facility’s existing device servers.

description.zh: 提供独立进程和 IOC 内嵌两种入口，把 EPICS PV 和控制命令暴露给 Agent。
description.en: Offers standalone-process and IOC-embedded entry points exposing EPICS PVs and control commands to agents.

evidence.zh: C++ 共享库和协议分派结构公开；未识别到许可证。
evidence.en: C++ shared-library and protocol-dispatch structure is public; no license was identified.

description.zh: 通过串口连接 MCU 与 Agent，适合作为自制仪器的基础通信桥。
description.en: Connects microcontrollers to agents through serial communication, useful as a basic bridge for custom instruments.

evidence.zh: README 给出 Pico 等接入流程；串口传输本身不定义仪器的量纲、状态或完成条件。
evidence.en: The README provides Pico integration workflows; serial transport alone does not define units, device state or completion conditions.

description.zh: 将 Golioth 设备 RPC 及其描述动态暴露为 MCP 工具，已有设备可通过状态服务发布工具 schema。
description.en: Exposes Golioth device RPCs as MCP tools; existing devices can publish tool schemas through the state service.

evidence.zh: 包含 Zephyr LED 控制示例；服务代码开源，但运行依赖 Golioth 平台，不能当作纯离线通用设备协议。
evidence.en: Includes a Zephyr LED-control example. Server code is open source, while operation depends on the Golioth platform.

description.zh: 让 Agent 连接调试探针、控制目标、读写内存、设断点、刷写与检查故障，为仪器固件开发提供物理反馈。
description.en: Connects agents to debug probes for target control, memory access, breakpoints, flashing and fault inspection, supplying physical feedback during instrument-firmware development.

evidence.zh: 维护者声明在真实 ESP32-S3 上验证；原生 probe-rs 和 OpenOCD 后端分开配置。
evidence.en: Maintainers report validation on a physical ESP32-S3; native probe-rs and OpenOCD backends are configured separately.

description.zh: 逻辑分析仪的采集、协议解码、时序测量和导出接口，用于固件与真实总线调试。
description.en: Logic-analyzer capture, protocol decoding, timing measurement and export for firmware and physical-bus debugging.

evidence.zh: 依赖已开启自动化接口的 Saleae Logic 2；该软件和硬件不随开源服务提供。
evidence.en: Requires Saleae Logic 2 with automation enabled; the application and hardware are not supplied by the open server.

description.zh: 通过串口或 WebREPL 操作 ESP32/RP2040 等，利用设备侧 helper 模块和 HARDWARE.md 保存板级知识。
description.en: Operates ESP32/RP2040-class boards through serial or WebREPL, using device-side helper modules and HARDWARE.md for board-specific knowledge.

evidence.zh: 提供实机测试 CLI 和固件接入说明；未识别到顶层许可证。
evidence.en: Provides a hardware-test CLI and firmware setup instructions; no top-level license was identified.

description.zh: 经 rosbridge 发现主题、服务、动作与消息类型，发布控制消息并读取机器人传感器反馈。
description.en: Uses rosbridge to discover topics, services, actions and message types, publish control messages and read robot-sensor feedback.

evidence.zh: 仓库附机器人演示；适配覆盖 ROS 通信层，具体运动能力和控制器仍在机器人自身系统中。
evidence.en: Robot demonstrations are included. The bridge covers ROS communication; motion capabilities and controllers remain in the robot stack.

description.zh: JPL 的 ROS 自然语言助手，结合系统诊断、状态查询与可扩展机器人操作工具。
description.en: JPL’s natural-language ROS assistant combines system diagnostics, state queries and extensible robot-operation tools.

evidence.zh: 论文与示例覆盖机器人应用；ROSA 是 Agent 工具框架，不能由名称推断具有原生 MCP。
evidence.en: The paper and examples cover robotic applications. ROSA is an agent/tool framework; native MCP is not inferred from its purpose.

description.zh: 用屏幕观察、规划和鼠标键盘操作包装仪器软件，配套设备 profile。适用于 API 缺失时的替代接入研究。
description.en: Wraps instrument software through screen observation, planning and mouse/keyboard actions with device profiles. Relevant when an API is unavailable.

evidence.zh: 公开实现含 NMR 数据处理与酶标仪模块；MCP 工具存在不等于全部列出的商业仪器都已完成物理控制验证。
evidence.en: Public implementation includes NMR-data and plate-reader modules. MCP tools do not establish physical-control validation for every named commercial instrument.

description.zh: 仪器操作知识与技能材料，与 device-use 的执行接口配套。
description.en: Instrument operating knowledge and skill material accompanying device-use execution interfaces.

evidence.zh: 技能是知识与操作说明；独立收录为配套资料，不计作设备驱动或独立实机系统。
evidence.en: Skills contain knowledge and operating instructions; listed as supporting material rather than device drivers or an independently validated hardware system.

description.zh: 在 Agent 与设备服务之间加入边缘网关，处理身份、参数约束、配额与审计。
description.en: An edge gateway between agents and device services for identity, parameter constraints, quotas and audit records.

evidence.zh: README 将其定位为参考实现并使用 mock 后端；不是 Anthropic 官方 MHS 服务端。
evidence.en: The README identifies a reference implementation with mock backends, not an official Anthropic MHS server.

description.zh: 讨论 Agent 与实验设备连接的协议构想。
description.en: A protocol concept for connecting agents to laboratory devices.

evidence.zh: 核查仓库树只有 README、LICENSE 与忽略文件，没有协议实现或设备驱动。
evidence.en: The reviewed tree contains only README, LICENSE and an ignore file, with no protocol implementation or device driver.

description.zh: 化学工具增强 Agent 的重要案例，可用于理解工具编排和实验服务边界。
description.en: An important chemistry tool-augmented agent case for understanding orchestration and experimental-service boundaries.

evidence.zh: 论文有实验执行，但 README 明确公共包因 API 限制不包含论文所有工具；不据论文补写未公开的硬件接口。
evidence.en: The paper includes experimental execution, but the README explicitly says API restrictions exclude some paper tools from the public package.

description.zh: NV 中心自主实验的公共案例、分析代码与实验资料。
description.en: Public case studies, analysis code and experimental artifacts for autonomous NV-center experiments.

evidence.zh: 许可和发布说明明确未包含 live-laboratory backend；可研究实验轨迹，不能直接当作完整 NV 设备控制软件。
evidence.en: Release and license notes explicitly omit the live-laboratory backend. Useful for experimental trajectories, not a complete NV-device control release.

description.zh: 围绕真实 UC2 显微镜和 ImSwitch API 的教学入口，包括设备构成、接入与实验挑战。
description.en: A teaching entry point for physical UC2 microscopes and the ImSwitch API, covering hardware, access and experimental challenges.

evidence.zh: 是课程与示例资料，不是独立完整的 Agent 平台；未识别到许可证。
evidence.en: Workshop and example material rather than a complete independent agent platform; no license was identified.
